newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BELGIAN IPSO GROUP IPO PRICED AT 1,500 BFR/SHR.
newsitem.headline: BELGIAN IPSO GROUP IPO PRICED AT 1,500 BFR/SHR.

text.p: Shares in Belgian IPSO-ILG Industrial Laundry Group are priced at 1,500 francs each, the group said in a statement on Friday.
Subscriptions for private investors start on Monday and will run until June 20, unless the issue is closed early.
The offer, a combined private placement for institutional investors and an initial public offer for private investors, involves 960,000 existing shares and 100,000 new shares.
The private placement closed early on Friday.
Institutional investors will receive a total 636,000 shares, the rest -- 424,000 -- will be offered to retail investors.
The prospectus is available from brokerage Petercam and bank Generale Bank .
-- Geert De Clercq, Brussels Newsroom +32 2 287 6813, Fax +32 2 230 7710
